test_ensure_platform_int: test the libalgos.ensure_platform_int function to convert numpy arrays to platform int type
test_is_lexsorted: test the libalgos.is_lexsorted function to check if arrays are lexicographically sorted
test_groupsort_indexer: test the libalgos.groupsort_indexer function to compute stable group sort indexers for numpy arrays
